page.overview:
Who is Arahael?

Arahael was the first of Isildur's Heirs to be born after the destruction of the North-kingdom. His father Aranarth therefore gave him over to Elrond while he dwelt in the wild, to be fostered in Rivendell, and this became the custom of the Chieftains of the North.

Arahael became the second chieftain in TA 2106. He led the Dúnedain during the time known as the Watchful Peace, and was untroubled by war.

Arahael died in TA 2177 after serving as Chieftain for seventy-one years. He was succeeded by his son Aranuir.

Arahael is a Sindarin word that means "Wise King", from the prefix -ara ("king") and hael or sael ("wise").
